connector.name: Luca MCP
connector.registryDescription: Work your Luca workspace from any MCP client: 67 tools for leads, conversations, and campaigns.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the leonardomso account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: LUCA_API_KEY
env.description: Luca developer API key (from Luca settings, developer API keys).

env.name: LUCA_API_BASE_URL
env.description: Luca API origin. Defaults to https://api.setluca.com.

env.name: LUCA_WORKSPACE_SLUG
env.description: Optional default workspace slug for every call.
